file_name: I Squared Capital - oOhmedia - third-party questionnaire.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if any businesses controlled or managed by I Squared Capital are close competitors to oOh!media and there are not many alternatives or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.

Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with I Squared Capital, oOh!media and/or any other business controlled or managed by I Squared Capital active in the advertising sector.
